icn.purpose: ICN monorepo: daemon, substrate libraries, website, ops, SDK, web apps

homelab-inventory.purpose: Infrastructure inventory and automation for the homelab (Python 3.12+)
homelab-inventory.notes: Manages the infrastructure ICN runs on. icn-ops observes but never mutates homelab state.

org_repos.description: InterCooperative-Network org repos and adjacent private layers, seen from icn: repo discovery / coordination metadata for the ecosystem control plane. NOT architectural truth — ops/state/truth/sources.json wins on any truth-ownership conflict, and docs/ATLAS.md + ops/state/ecosystem.json remain the role/boundary index. Fields record CURRENT state only (a null lock/envelope means none exists yet; planned is not done). stack_stage = cross-repo merge order per ops/coordination/PR_STACK_PROTOCOL.md (1=icn canonical first; 6=org profile mirror last; null=not part of PR stacks).

nycn.role_note: First institution ecosystem package (NYCN / Summit 2026); depends on icn via a human-signed review-attestation lock. Status envelope + claim-lint caller landed via nycn#81 (caller pinned to icn 36f5b08c); warning-mode enforcement is advisory, not a runtime/readiness claim

icn-infra.role_note: Org operating contracts: cross-repo boundary, public-claims gates, source classification

icn-learn.role_note: ICN Academy: teaches from canonical sources, is never canonical. First ICN upstream lock + status envelope + claim-lint caller landed via icn-learn#4 (caller pinned to icn d944cf04); lock carries reviewer: pending (machine-prepared, not human-signed). Warning-mode enforcement is advisory, not a runtime/readiness claim; icn-learn consumes no ICN runtime contract

icn-community-bridge.role_note: Discord-to-Matrix onboarding bridge: policy/scaffold only, not deployed, no governance authority, no canonical truth. First ICN upstream lock + status envelope + claim-lint caller landed via icn-community-bridge#2 (caller pinned to icn d944cf04); lock carries reviewer: pending (machine-prepared, not human-signed). Warning-mode enforcement is advisory, not a runtime/readiness claim

org-github.role_note: Org profile mirror: mirrors public icn truth, originates no claims, updated last in any stack

network-ops.role_note: Provider/personal layer (most private), access-gated outside the GitHub org; feeds icn-infra only via the ADR-0005 scrub gate; never referenced by concrete pointer from public icn

demo-repository.role_note: role: none — GitHub-generated demo noise per docs/reference/project-index/repository-map.md; archive-or-ignore decision pending

worktrees.notes: Resolved relative to the monorepo root. Canonical dev-VM layout: bare stores in ~/icn-dev/repos/*.git with worktrees at ~/icn-dev/worktrees/icn/<name>, so sibling worktrees live one level up ('..'). The older repo-adjacent ../icn-wt layout is retired (legacy); ops/mcp/src/paths.ts resolveWorktreeRoot() keeps it only as a last-resort fallback (ICN_WT_ROOT env overrides everything).
worktrees.managed_by: ~/icn-dev/scripts (wt-new / wt-pr / wt-status / wt-clean) on the dev VM; scripts/worktrees.sh remains for the legacy layout

relationships.mechanism: website reads ../docs via path.resolve at build time (no sync script)

relationships.notes: homelab-inventory data/llm-context/ bundles are authoritative infra state
